title: John Hendricks and the Armstrong-Ellington record
summary: Hendricks also watched Louis closely; Young enjoyed the record of Armstrong's band with Duke at the piano.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: And John Hendricks told me he used to watch him just as hard. You know, John knows -- he knows what he's doing. He's no dummy, man. He said he watched -- he watched Louie, and he learned an awful lot from Louie. Anyone could. Duke loved him. You know, did you hear the record, thing we did with Duke, Louis' little band and Duke at the piano?
It was a cute little thing they did. It was very cute. I enjoyed it. I really enjoyed doing that
thing, and we did Duke's tunes, you know, on those things, and it was cute.
